## Research Domains (named clusters within the AUGMANITAI Compendium)

Featured domain pages with full term listings:
- /domains/subjective-phenomenology/ - 8,063 RPH terms (subjective experience in human-AI interaction)
- /domains/cross-domain-pool/ - 2,553 WK terms (cross-disciplinary terminology bridging the framework)
- /domains/neomanitai-knowledge-graph/ - 2,439 NEO terms (cross-reference and ontological-relation layer)
- /domains/augmanitai-core/ - 1,816 AUG terms (canonical descriptive terminology baseline)
- /domains/ - master index of all 169 clusters

Named framework branches: AUGMANITAI · NEOMANITAI (Knowledge Graph layer) · PERMANITAI (Substrate-Independent Performance Factor framework) · ROBMANITAI (Robotics Human-AI Interaction Phenomenology, extending to multi-robot coordination, human-robot team dynamics, and multi-agent / agent-team orchestration) · EDUMANITAI · JOBMANITAI

## Methodological Frame

Holistic Performance Analysis Methodology (Observable / Decomposable / Measurable / Controllable) — a cross-domain transfer of high-performance sport-science methodology (25-year Bundesliga tennis coaching lineage) to human-AI interaction analysis and multi-agent / robot-team performance.

Multi-LLM Triadic Audit Framework · Cross-LLM Convergence Methodology · N=1 Extreme Observation Methodology · Compression Axiom · Living-Document Discipline · ISO 704/1087/30042 aligned Terminology Engineering.

## What is publicly indexable

Per-term HTML pages at /atlas/{slug}/ contain inline JSON-LD (Schema.org DefinedTerm + skos:Concept + prov:Entity). All terms discoverable via sitemap.xml. Domain overviews at /domains/.

Bulk machine-readable exports at /exports/:
- /exports/all-terms.jsonl - one DefinedTerm per line (35,852 lines, ~25 MB) - streaming-friendly
- /exports/all-terms-graph.json - single JSON-LD @graph (35,852 terms, ~27 MB) - SPARQL/RDF-ready
- /exports/domain-index.json - cluster-prefix to term-list mapping (169 clusters)

## What is NOT publicly distributed at this stage

Operational-layer details: scoring algorithms, proprietary training pipelines,
internal audit-procedure mechanics, subscription-architecture internals, full
relations-graph traversal data, ROS2 messages, methodology operational steps.

These are stored in a restricted Zenodo deposit (Concept-DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20118267, files locked, metadata public). Recital 173 EU AI Act trade-secret reservation applies.

## Researcher access

Researchers seeking access to bulk deep-layer for legitimate scholarly purposes contact via ORCID-linked channels: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-3773-7796 or augmanitai@gmail.com. Subject to brief research-purpose statement and attribution agreement.
